'''Highway Reaver''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|An armed criminal active in Wuling territories. They would usually set up illegal road barricades or engage in the smuggling of illegal goods. Some of them would even attack travelers.}}
